name: taskrail
description: Inspect and manage local computer automations through a typed, approval-aware MCP server with a safe host overview.

interface.longDescription: Taskrail connects a user-owned macOS, Linux, or Windows automation daemon to an MCP host. It provides a safe host overview, discovers native jobs, reports runs and logs, summarizes typed integrations, and keeps local writes behind explicit policy and approvals.
defaultPrompt: Give me a complete local automation overview.
Discover the native scheduler jobs on this host.
Explain the latest failed automation run.
